jobs.description:
You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 

the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 

sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 

develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization) 

• Design and deploy 
Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking 

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance 

optimization 

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning 

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands  

That's why this job suits you:
 
 

• You are hands-on and have 3-5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation 

• Thorough knowledge of 
ROS2, C, C++, and Python 

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields: 
 

• Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization 

• Control systems for robotics 

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM) 

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics   

• You’re comfortable working with hardware and in realworld field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment 

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work 

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments) 

• You can communicate fluently in English

About this job
For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

You will be responsible for the assembly and mounting of products.
You will be trained as a multi-skilled worker and deployed across 8 different workstations.

You are able to work in a two-shift system and can work both independently and as part of a team.
You already have some initial experience in assembly work.
You are punctual and work accurately.
You speak English or Dutch so that you can communicate with colleagues.

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
